anya-ops: Copy. Allowlist + routing preference required?

maria-cs: Both. Pin to sg-edge cluster; avoid fallback unless capacity exhausted. This is a renewal signal.

derek-infra: I'll add a provisional routing override and ACL; will schedule auto-revoke after 72h. Plan config push to staging for smoke tests.

paul-rls: Tagging capacity planning and renewal follow-up. If p95 <200ms we should discuss Dedicated upsell in 60d.

sam-support: Compliance check: confirm demo uses de-identified data before keeping 30d logs. Maria, please attach DPA.

maria-cs: Confirmed de-identified; will attach DPA to ticket CS-8342 and run enablement call 2026-04-04.

derek-infra: Staging push OK, promoting to prod with auto-revoke.

deploy-bot: deploy 2581 -> provisional sg-routing + ip acl applied; monitor enabled.

anya-ops: Auto-revoke scheduled 2026-04-08T08:01:00Z.

paul-rls: Post-demo eval checklist added to CS-8342: p95 latency, error rate, cost/1k tokens.

maria-cs: Will collect feedback on the enablement call and capture renewal sentiment. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
